summary: 25 of 26 sub-steps present, 1 absent (M2), 0 wrong. The plan carries the bank-exchange, label-residual, phase-interface, rank-saving and simultaneous-layer derivations in full, mostly through quotes of the paper's own proof lines placed in the paper's role. The one gap is the fixed-prime choice in the matrix-shear lemma, where the plan states only that a fixed odd prime exists, without the finite table of factors, the denominator avoidance, or the specialization to Z/q^b with invertible triangular factors.
